about_the_game:
Arcade drift physics • 50+ legendary cars • Story campaign • Visual customization • Online PvP & co-op • Cross-platform competitions • Daily & weekly events with prizes • Weekly leaderboards • Controller & Steam Deck support • Low-spec friendly

Drift Legends 2 is an arcade drifting game built for pure style, collection and competition. Start your journey from rookie to elite in a full story campaign, collect 50+ beautifully detailed cars — from JDM icons to American muscle and European legends — and dominate in online PvP and co-op events. Show your identity with visual customization (paints, liveries, wheels, tires, license plates), climb weekly leaderboards, and win cosmetics and premium cars. The game features controller support, is optimized for Steam Deck, and runs great on everyday PCs.

Key Features

  • Arcade drift physics — smooth, responsive and satisfying slides.

  • 50+ legendary cars — JDM classics, raw muscle and timeless European machines.

  • [b]Story campaign (beginners→elite) — prove yourself and unlock new chapters.

  • Online PvP & co-op — ranked duels, team challenges and casual rooms.

  • Cross-platform competitions— play with friends across platforms.

  • Daily & weekly events with prizes — chase new goals every day.

  • Weekly leaderboards— compete for top spots and exclusive rewards.

  • Visual customization only— paints, liveries, wheels, tires, license plates (no performance tuning, no pay-to-win).

  • Controller support & Steam Deck optimization — pick up and drift anywhere.

  • Low-spec friendly — designed to run smoothly on typical office PCs.

Why you’ll love it

If you enjoy the style and freedom of Forza Horizon and the high-energy vibe of Need for Speed, this is your drift playground: collect legends, perfect your lines and rule the leaderboards — for free.

Note: customization affects visuals only and does not provide gameplay advantages.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel® 4590 or AMD Ryzen3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11 compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: The application’s stability is not guaranteed on Intel HD Graphics and AMD HD Radeon on-board graphics cards.

  • OS: SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-8300H @ 2.30GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11 compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: The application’s stability is not guaranteed on Intel HD Graphics and AMD HD Radeon on-board graphics cards.
